activation_diffs.generator_rule: Only BANK_GENERATION_AUTHORIZED changes False to True.
activation_diffs.launcher_rule: Only BANK_GENERATION_AUTHORIZED changes False to True.
activation_diffs.sha256_pins: External, pinned in lc518_generation_gate.py and SHA256SUMS to avoid a circular launcher/protocol hash dependency.

artifact_policy.upload_directory: RUN_ROOT including logs/stderr.log, logs/stdout.log, logs/run_manifest.json, banks, sidecars, oracle attachments and canonical-disjointness report when produced

design_of_record.note: The exact C9 revision 2.6 source at the pinned commit stated that ratification was pending. On 2026-11-03 the owner explicitly wrote AUTHORIZED and directed: "1. MADE FIXES 2. PUSH THOSE FILES 3. GENERATE BANK". This is recorded as the owner ratification of this pinned revision and the separate GO below; it does not backdate the earlier status.

dispatch.policy: All three SHA-256 inputs and the exact owner-GO identifier must match source-pinned values before run-root creation. The GitHub lc518-bank-generation Environment also requires the designated owner reviewer approval before the generation job can start.
dispatch.workflow_ref_policy: Only the generation-enabled recovery branch is eligible through the named GitHub Environment; reviewer approval is required for every deployment.

generator.pair_metadata_policy: For D6/H6, validate Candidate.candidate_id and Candidate.stratum against each contained record rule_params pair_id and ordering before oracle evaluation, hashing, or publication. Serialized pair_id and ordering remain only inside rule_params, per C9 §5.
generator.predicate_log_policy: Emit each H1-H4 predicate immediately after computing oracle_answer and N0, before fixed-witness assertion; flush stderr. Emit WITNESS_FAILURE immediately before raising on a failed fixed witness.

launcher.predeclared_activation_candidate_rule: Launcher state 2 differs from state 1 only by BANK_GENERATION_AUTHORIZED=False to True.

paths.stderr_creation: exclusive xb; created by the launcher after exclusive RUN_ROOT creation

protocol_hash_policy: External only. This exact canonical JSON file is pinned by SHA-256 in lc518_launcher.py and lc518_generation_gate.py. The protocol does not contain its own digest.
required_before_bank_generation: The exact protocol SHA-256 and owner-GO identifier must match the source-pinned workflow gate.
The exact generator and launcher activation-diff SHA-256 values must match source-pinned values.
The GitHub lc518-bank-generation Environment must approve the deployment before generation.
The locked workflow test suite, activation-candidate byte checks, runner-image pins, and interpreter pins must pass.

runner.drift_policy: Any mismatch in ImageOS, ImageVersion, sys.version, platform.platform(), resolved sys.executable, or SHA-256 of sys.executable is a hard refusal before RUN_ROOT creation. The launcher independently rechecks runner-image and interpreter pins.

test_suites.count_explanation: 57 = 43 generator + 14 launcher tests; 16 gate tests are additional; full total = 73.
